definition.name: H_temp
definition.formula: mean over d in {0,4,8,16,20,32} of abs(U_arm(d)-U_grip(d))
definition.aggregation: task-level profiles; each task has equal weight in macro summaries
definition.threshold_rule: For each group, threshold is the development-task median U_g(16); first available delay with U_g(d) below that threshold is descriptive only.
